The runtime spends the shared Focus Point resource, grants two Flurry Unarmed Strike action resources, applies Disengage/Dodge/Dash through the existing turn procedures, and records the paid Step of the Wind turn-scoped jump-distance multiplier consumed by promoted Jump spell movement replacement witnesses without duplicating Monk level, Martial Arts, movement state, or a synthetic option-local resource pool. Ordinary Long Jump and High Jump distance derivation, route, obstacle, destination, and landing adjudication remain table-owned movement facts outside this profile.

Failed D20 Test die use is represented by unit-feature.bardic-inspiration-failed-d20-test.

title: Unit feature adds 1d10 to an already-failed ability check using the Second Wind pool

Unit feature adds Proficiency Bonus to Initiative rolls and can swap Initiative once with a willing non-Incapacitated ally before turns begin
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes an admitted passive Surface shape with an Initiative Proficiency Bonus roll modifier and an immediate Initiative Swap atom. Character Battle derives the final Initiative score from the caller-supplied Initiative roll total, existing CharacterBuild level progression, and retained support profile when the player chooses to add the Proficiency Bonus. Battle runtime owns only the start-battle setup swap boundary: callers enter the setup workflow from BattleCreatureInit input, not from an arbitrary BattleState, so consumed source opportunities cannot be reset by re-entering setup after a swap. During setup, both combatants must be present in the same combat, on the same side, distinct, the ally must be willing, no combatant may have acted yet, neither participant may be Incapacitated, the source must not have consumed its one post-roll swap opportunity, and the existing Initiative scores are swapped and re-ordered without dispatching on Alert identity or storing parallel swap state in BattleState.

title: Unit feature passively grants Saving Throw roll mode while a condition predicate is absent
Unit feature passively grants target-side Resistance keyed to a typed or fixed damage fact
sourceBoundary: Character creation preserves selected source facts when a passive Resistance depends on a species-owned choice table, such as Draconic Ancestry. Fixed passive Resistance facts, such as Dwarven Resilience's Poison damage Resistance, derive their damage type directly from the passive grant_resistance Surface shape. Battle damage adjustment consumes the admitted character Unit support profile directly from characterUnitRefs without storing a separate resistance-only damage type field.

title: Unit feature can replace one missed attack roll with a hit until start of next turn
Unit feature admits and executes an Attack-action attack replacement with area Saving Throw damage
sourceBoundary: Character creation preserves one selected CharacterBuild Draconic Ancestry fact from the species-owned source table. Battle Unit admission derives that selected damage type from the CharacterBuild ancestry selection and selected species Surface source table together with the authored Breath Weapon Surface activation shape: replace one Attack-action attack, self-origin Cone or Line choice, Dexterity innate save DC from Constitution, character-level d10 damage tiers, half damage on success, Proficiency Bonus use cap, and Long Rest reset. Character battle initialization derives battle resources from retained build Unit refs so species traits with supported use-count mechanics are admitted without a parallel species-resource list. Runtime derives the executable Breath Weapon profile from the selected Unit support profile plus the resource Unit at discovery and resolution time, spends one use, replaces one Attack-action attack through the shared action-resource protocol, consumes table-supplied area membership and Saving Throw outcomes, validates the damage dice tier, and applies the selected Draconic Ancestry damage without dispatching on authored species or trait identity.

Cleave damage reuses the same weapon damage projection while suppressing positive ability modifiers and preserving negative modifiers.

title: Spell invocation creates a Concentration-owned magical Darkness point-origin Sphere

Runtime owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spend, 15-foot Sphere radius, caster-owned Concentration up to 10 minutes, active zone projection, ordinary-sight and Darkvision Heavily Obscured consequence, nonmagical-light denial as a witness consequence, overlap-triggered dispel of tracked spell-light emitters whose source spell level is 2 or lower without authored spell identity dispatch, and cleanup. Object-origin Emanation, opaque-cover blocking, automatic area membership, line-of-sight drawing, and map illumination remain outside this profile.

title: Spell invocation creates a source-owned object light emitter
sourceBoundary: Runtime consumes typed table-supplied object identity facts, emitter-distance facts, and opaque-cover witnesses. Light additionally consumes size and worn/carried facts and owns one-hour duration cleanup plus same-caster recast replacement. Continual Flame consumes a touched-object fact, owns level-2+ Spell Slot casting, source-owned object attachment, Bright/Dim 20-foot radii, non-ticking until-dispelled persistence, and preserves prior Continual Flame emitters from the same caster. Existing light projection derives Bright/Dim/Darkness to sight-obscurement and Darkvision-adjusted sight consequences without duplicating emitter state. Removal or suppression triggers such as Dispel Magic, Darkness overlap, and Antimagic Field are owned outside this object-emitter profile; this profile exposes object attachment and the until-dispelled marker for those removal or suppression owners, while any additional generic Spell Effect facts belong to the remover or suppressor owner rather than a Continual Flame-specific registry. Colored/flame presentation, automatic line-of-sight drawing, automatic map geometry/pathfinding derivation, non-heat/fuel presentation, smother/quenched adjudication, and costly consumed Material component availability/consumption are outside this object-emitter runtime boundary.

title: Spell invocation creates a movable Flaming Sphere fire hazard with reposition, end-within-5-feet, and ram saves
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes a typed table-supplied 5-foot-diameter sphere area identity, table-triggered end-within-5-feet witnesses, and table-supplied positive movement-distance witnesses capped at 30 feet for non-damaging reposition and ram movement into a creature's space. Runtime owns Magic Action and level-2+ Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration lifecycle, one-minute duration cleanup, Dexterity save-gated Fire damage with half damage on success, slot-scaled damage dice, and Bonus Action spending for reposition and ram commands. Automatic area membership, unoccupied-space validation, pathfinding, barrier/pit traversal, sphere stop-position tracking, object ignition, light rendering, and map geometry remain runtime-detached table adjudication or presentation outside this profile.

title: Spell invocation creates a source-owned held light emitter
sourceBoundary: Runtime owns the spell source, combatant attachment, Bright/Dim radii, timed duration, recast replacement, hurl cleanup, duration cleanup, and caller-supplied emitter projection facts for derived Bright/Dim/Darkness illumination to sight-obscurement and Darkvision-adjusted sight consequences. Map illumination rendering, opaque-cover suppression, automatic line-of-sight drawing, automatic map geometry/pathfinding derivation, and colored-light presentation remain outside this runtime boundary.

title: Spell invocation creates, releases, re-evokes, and attacks with a spell-created held object
sourceBoundary: Runtime admits the spell-created held-object lifecycle by exact Surface shape rather than authored identity. Runtime owns Bonus Action level-2-or-higher Spell Slot creation, canonical free-hand gating through armorClass hand-use plus Grapple occupancy, canonical hand occupancy and release for the spell-created held object, caster-owned Concentration and duration cleanup, active held/not-held spell occurrence state, source-owned held Bright/Dim light emitter projection while held, let-go cleanup to the not-held occurrence state, same-occurrence Bonus Action re-evocation without a Spell Slot spend, and active-object-gated Magic Action melee spell attack with Fire damage slot scaling plus spellcasting ability modifier. Table map reach/adjudication, flame presentation, and Material component availability or consumption remain outside this profile.

title: Spell invocation creates movable linked Dancing Lights Dim Light emitters
sourceBoundary: Caller-supplied Dancing Lights placement facts; runtime owns the spell source, source-owned dancing-light identities, separate-light and combined Medium-form emitter projection, 10-foot Dim Light radius, one-minute Concentration duration, recast replacement, Concentration cleanup, Bonus Action repositioning up to 60 feet, 20-foot inter-light spacing validation, 120-foot range expiry, and caller-supplied emitter projection facts for derived Dim/Darkness illumination to sight-obscurement and Darkvision-adjusted sight consequences. Map illumination rendering, color presentation, automatic line-of-sight drawing, pathfinding, automatic geometry derivation, and generic illusion adjudication remain outside this runtime boundary.

title: Spell invocation records failed-save Command Grovel and Halt pending effects and resolves them at the target turn
sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command's cast shell, slot-scaled creature target list, Wisdom save, and the Grovel and Halt options. Drop is represented by spell.invocation-command-drop-held-object; Approach is represented by spell.invocation-command-approach-route; Flee is represented by spell.invocation-command-flee-route.

title: Spell invocation resolves Command Drop through held-object facts and dropped-object outcomes
sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command Drop by consuming canonical character loadout held-object facts when present or caller-supplied held-object facts otherwise, emitting dropped-object outcomes, and ending the target turn. It does not add general inventory simulation, object placement, or loadout mutation.

title: Spell invocation resolves Command Approach through caller-supplied shortest-direct-route movement facts
sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command Approach by consuming caller-supplied route/proximity facts on the existing Movement fill when movement is available, spending the target's movement through the normal movement reducer, and ending the target turn only when that supplied route reaches within 5 feet of the caster. If the target has no available movement, it clears the pending Approach effect without ending the turn. It does not add pathfinding or route storage.

title: Spell invocation resolves Command Flee through caller-supplied fastest-available moving-away route facts
sourceBoundary: This profile supports Command Flee by consuming caller-supplied fastest-available moving-away route facts on the existing Movement fill, requiring the selected remaining Movement budget to be spent when movement is available, clearing the pending effect, and ending the target turn. If the target has no available movement, it clears the pending Flee effect and ends the turn without a Movement fill. Opportunity Attack eligibility is derived from the Movement fill's actual provoked-threat facts, not from Command route metadata. It does not add pathfinding, route storage, or route-choice policy.

title: Spell invocation immediately resolves Dash and grants Concentration-owned Bonus Action Dash
sourceBoundary: Movement budget updates reuse the battle Dash/action owner; the spell effect stores only the Concentration-owned permission to take Dash as a Bonus Action.

title: Spell invocation reacts to falling creatures with per-target Feather Fall mitigation
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes typed table-supplied falling-trigger, falling target, range, and landing witnesses. It spends the caster's Reaction and Spell Slot, admits up to five falling targets within range, creates one-minute per-target mitigation effects, exposes the 60-foot descent-rate cap projection, and clears the landed target's mitigation while emitting fall-damage prevention and Falling-Prone prevention outcomes. Fall-distance derivation, map elevation, and landing-geometry derivation remain runtime-detached table adjudication outside this profile.

title: Reaction spell opens Hellish Rebuke after-damage casting window
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes caller-supplied after-damage facts establishing that the damaged reactor took damage from a visible creature within 60 feet, requires Hellish Rebuke spell access, an available Reaction, and an available Spell Slot, then opens an after-damage Reaction frame carrying the damager, damaged reactor, and slot-level continuation facts. The continuation resolves through the shared save-gated damage invocation profile.

title: Reaction spell interrupts a visible spell cast through Counterspell
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes typed table-supplied spell-cast Reaction facts establishing that a reactor can see a spell caster within 60 feet, requires Counterspell spell access, an available Reaction, an available Spell Slot, and the SRD same-turn spell-slot ledger, opens a spell-cast Reaction frame before the triggering spell resolves, resolves automatic or Constitution-save-gated interruption, releases the triggering pending slot when the spell is countered, and exposes nested spell-cast Reaction facts so Counterspell can itself be countered. Spell visibility, range geometry, and component witnesses remain table-supplied facts.

title: Spell invocation grants once-per-target-turn jump movement replacement
sourceBoundary: The runtime owns touched willing target admission, one-minute active effect duration, per-target-turn use reset, and the 10-foot Movement spend for a base maximum 30 feet of jump movement, with active turn-scoped jump-distance multipliers consumed when present. It consumes typed table-supplied jump distance and landing witnesses; legal-destination and Difficult Terrain landing Acrobatics outcomes arrive as landing witness variants, illegal landings are rejected, and failed Difficult Terrain landing applies Prone. Path, jump arc, collision, final-position, legal-destination derivation, and Difficult Terrain landing Dexterity (Acrobatics) check derivation remain runtime-detached table adjudication outside this profile.

title: Spell invocation consumes caller-supplied failed-save Reaction movement facts
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes Reaction availability, caller-supplied safest-route Movement, and table-supplied Opportunity Attack threats; route/pathfinding geometry is not derived inside the reducer. Package-local Quint models the reducer protocol for Reaction spend, no-movement fallback, Movement fill admission, Opportunity Attack interruption, and after-damage continuation ordering.

Spell invocation makes a zero-Hit-Point non-dead creature Stable

Stat Block combatants that die at 0 HP and Character Build combatants whose death-save lifecycle is dead are not legal targets.

Spell invocation spends a Bonus Action and Spell Slot after an eligible weapon hit to restrain the target, deal turn-start damage, and allow escape
Spell invocation spends a Bonus Action and Spell Slot after an eligible melee hit to add damage, store timed start-turn damage, and save-to-end

It owns the Bonus Action cantrip cast, attached item identity, spellcasting ability attack and damage projection, character-level damage die scaling, Force-or-normal damage type choice, same-caster recast replacement, and projection stop when the attached item is no longer held. Generic inventory, item conjuration, automatic hand occupancy mutation, and unrelated weapon overrides remain outside this profile.

title: Spell invocation applies a creature size change with Strength roll modes and attack-hit damage adjustment
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored creature-target Enlarge/Reduce branch, caller-selected creature target and mode, table-supplied range and willingness facts, and Saving Throw outcomes for unwilling targets. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, prior Concentration loss when casting this Concentration spell, new caster-owned Concentration only when the creature effect applies, active one-step creature Size projection, Strength Ability Check and Strength Saving Throw roll modes with normal Advantage/Disadvantage cancellation, weapon or Unarmed Strike attack-hit 1d4 damage addition or subtraction with the Reduce minimum-damage floor, a single active creature size-change effect per target under ASSUMPTIONS.md A48, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. Object targets, worn or carried item size changes, dropped-item normalization, and thrown weapon or ammunition normalization remain outside this creature-branch profile subset.

Color rendering, automatic line-of-sight drawing, and automatic map geometry/pathfinding derivation are runtime-detached table adjudication/presentation outside this outline/emitter boundary.

Hostile-to-Indifferent Attitude changes, chosen attitude recipients, damage or witness early ends, and return-to-normal social state are table/social-state facts outside this battle-runtime profile.

It records companion lifecycle and replacement state, inserts a present familiar as an allied combatant with its own Initiative turn and ordinary action/Reaction resources, allows supported non-attack actions, rejects ordinary Find Familiar attacks, projects telepathic communication without shared language, applies the caster Bonus Action shared-senses effect until the caster's next turn, resolves Touch spell delivery atomically with the familiar Reaction spend, and resolves the Pact of the Chain familiar attack exception atomically with one owner Attack-action attack forgone and the familiar Reaction spent.

sourceBoundary: CharacterBuild same-class progression plus Surface class-feature acquisition choices that grant known level-0 spell access with a class-level-gain replacement fact; replacement is accepted only as part of that class level gain, rewrites the existing class spellcasting source cantrip list, advances list-prepared spell choices and spell slots from the Surface class progression row, and does not retain duplicate branch or selected-cantrip state.

sourceBoundary: Surface Warlock Pact Magic progression rows and class spell list facts project into the CharacterBuild Warlock spellcasting source and Pact Magic slot pool during Warlock class-level gains; spell execution and selected invocation execution remain owned by selected spell and invocation profiles.

title: Character Creation finalizes Weapon Mastery weapon choices as selected class-choice refs
sourceBoundary: Surface Weapon Mastery class-feature records plus class weapon proficiencies and Character Draft selections; mastery-property execution remains owned by selected mastery Unit profiles.

title: Character Creation advances Fighter and Barbarian Weapon Mastery selected weapon refs during class-level gains
sourceBoundary: CharacterBuild Fighter or Barbarian progression plus the retained Surface Weapon Mastery class-feature ref and class-level choice-count table; level gain accepts selected weapon refs only for the gaining class feature, preserves existing selected refs, adds exactly the new table-count delta, enforces eligible weapon refs, and does not own selected mastery-property execution.

sourceBoundary: Warlock Eldritch Invocations class-feature choice, Surface Warlock Eldritch Invocation count facts, current CharacterBuild Warlock Pact Magic cantrip Spell Access facts, and the runtime SRD Eldritch Invocation option catalog; CharacterBuild stores selected Eldritch Invocation ownership plus Repeatable associated choice identity while selected Eldritch Invocation execution remains owned by selected Eldritch Invocation runtime profiles.

sourceBoundary: Surface class-feature resource container and resource-pool records, option metadata, save DC source facts, and known-form roster records projected from class progression into CharacterBuild resource and character facts; selected option, shape-shifted form, Sorcery Point conversion, and Metamagic execution remain owned by selected option or narrower runtime profiles.

Later spell-slot-level access is split to a future character-advancement owner.

sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Thaumaturgy Booming Voice cantrip effect, a caller-supplied count of total currently active Thaumaturgy 1-minute effects, and caller-created Charisma (Intimidation) Ability Check witnesses. The table owns whether an Influence action or other adjudication creates that check, its DC, targets, hearing and voice fiction, and outcome. Other Thaumaturgy minor wonders and their non-battle presentation/environment effects remain runtime-detached table adjudication.

sourceBoundary: CharacterBuild class progression, Surface Bard level 2 feature grant, CharacterBuild skill and Expertise proficiency facts, caller-supplied Ability Check skill witness, and caller-supplied no-other-Proficiency-Bonus gate.

sourceBoundary: CharacterBuild Warlock level-2 progression plus installed Magical Cunning class-feature Unit and Pact Magic slot pool state derived from the Warlock class record.

title: Character Sheet tracks rest-reset class-feature use-count resources
sourceBoundary: CharacterBuild class-feature resources plus installed Surface reset cadence, option metadata, save DC source facts, and known-form roster facts; Character Sheet stores expended use-count state, derives capacity and Short Rest or Long Rest recovery from the feature and class progression, and exposes per-feature projections such as Druid Wild Shape known forms and Monk's Focus save DC without storing duplicate derived state. Wild Shape builds must provide explicit selected known-form identities, and App, MCP, and Character Sheet battle handoff boundaries must pass through or preserve that selected known-form state rather than defaulting from recommendations.

title: Character Sheet tracks rest-reset class-feature point-pool resources
sourceBoundary: CharacterBuild class-feature point-pool resources plus installed Surface Long Rest reset facts; Character Sheet stores only expended point-pool state, derives capacity from the feature and class progression, and clears the expenditure on Long Rest without executing Spell Slot conversion or Metamagic options.

title: Character Sheet converts Font of Magic Spell Slots into Sorcery Points
sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes retained Font of Magic source facts, source-aware ordinary or created Spell Slot expenditure state, and the shared Sorcery Point point-pool expenditure. The conversion spends one unexpended Spell Slot, requires an explicit slot source when ordinary and created Spell Slots of the same level are both available, and restores expended Sorcery Points equal to the slot level only when the full gain fits under the Sorcerer-level cap; Pact Slots and Metamagic execution remain outside this profile.

title: Character Sheet creates Font of Magic Spell Slots from Sorcery Points
sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes retained Font of Magic source facts, the shared Sorcery Point point-pool expenditure, and the Creating Spell Slots table from the installed Surface feature. This is a Character Sheet conversion-state boundary: it spends the table cost, enforces the Sorcerer-level minimum and level-5 table cap, stores only created Spell Slot delta state, exposes aggregate Spell Slot capacity to Character Battle init, rejects source-ambiguous battle handoff expenditure for levels with both ordinary and created slots, and clears created slots on Long Rest. Character Battle does not advertise this conversion as a Unit feature Bonus Action or duplicate ordinary-vs-created source pools; battle use remains aggregate and source-ambiguous settlement is rejected.

title: Character Battle carries Metamagic facts with the shared Sorcery Point pool
sourceBoundary: Character Sheet preserves selected Metamagic option facts and validates that they match the retained Sorcerer Metamagic feature before Character Battle consumes those CharacterBuild facts and the existing Font of Magic point-pool resource projection. Battle state stores only the shared Sorcery Point point-pool remaining points plus Metamagic effectKind, stackingMode, and cost facts; it does not create a Metamagic-local pool or execute cast-time Metamagic options. Character Sheet handoff persists battle point-pool spending back as the Font of Magic pointPoolResource expenditure.

title: Character Sheet tracks once-per-Long-Rest class-feature use state
sourceBoundary: Character Sheet stores feature-scoped used-since-Long-Rest state only for retained class features with authored Long Rest reset facts, preserves that state across Short Rests, clears it on Long Rest, and derives related source links from CharacterBuild and Surface facts rather than storing duplicate resource or die projections.

title: Character Sheet applies Monk Uncanny Metabolism when rolling Initiative
sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes retained Uncanny Metabolism source facts, the shared Monk's Focus use-count expenditure owner, current Martial Arts die source projection, and once-per-Long-Rest use state at the Initiative roll boundary; it recovers all expended Focus Points, applies capped self Hit Point healing, records the Long Rest use marker, and Character Battle init carries the updated sheet resource and HP state into battle without a duplicate battle resource pool.

title: Spell invocation spends a Bonus Action and Spell Slot to teleport the caster to a caller-supplied unoccupied visible destination
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Misty Step spell, a caller-supplied unoccupied visible destination within 30 feet, and caller-supplied Antimagic Field origin/destination aura-membership witnesses for each active aura. It spends the caster's Bonus Action and Spell Slot, emits a self-teleport outcome, records that teleportation spends no Movement, provokes no Opportunity Attacks, and carries worn and carried equipment, and rejects teleportation across an active Antimagic Field aura boundary before spending resources. Automatic visibility, occupancy, blocked-destination fallback, map-position derivation, destination aura-membership derivation, and plane state remain table/spatial facts outside this runtime boundary.

title: Spell invocation applies concentration attack-roll Disadvantage against the caster with Blindsight and Truesight bypass witnesses
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Blur spell and caller-supplied attack-target spatial facts for Blindsight or Truesight perception; it owns the self Spell Effect, Attack Roll Disadvantage projection against the caster, Advantage/Disadvantage cancellation, Spell Slot spend, and Concentration cleanup.

title: Spell invocation creates timed Mirror Image duplicates that can intercept attack-roll hits
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Mirror Image spell, the attacker's Blinded condition, and caller-supplied attack-target spatial facts for Blindsight or Truesight perception. It owns Magic Action and Spell Slot spend, the self timed duplicate pool, d6-per-remaining-duplicate hit interception, duplicate destruction, final-duplicate cleanup, and normal continuation when the duplicate roll fails.

title: Spell invocation removes a condition and grants duration-bound damage Resistance plus condition-scoped Saving Throw Advantage
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes authored direct condition-removal, damage Resistance, and condition-scoped Saving Throw Advantage facts on one touched creature. It spends the Magic Action and Spell Slot, removes the named condition and spell-owned active effects that directly apply it, records duration-bound target-side damage Resistance and condition-scoped Saving Throw roll-mode effects, applies damage Resistance through the normal target-side damage adjustment pipeline, and projects Advantage for Saving Throws to avoid or end the named condition.

title: Spell invocation creates a paired Warding Bond effect with range-gated defenses and damage sharing
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Warding Bond linked-bond Surface shape plus caller-supplied willing-target, paired worn platinum-ring, and 60-foot connection/separation facts. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, a paired bond occurrence, target +1 Armor Class and Saving Throw projections, all-damage Resistance while connected, same-amount post-target-damage sharing to the caster, and cleanup on duration expiry, caster 0 Hit Points, separation, or recast on either connected creature without duplicating inventory or generic position state.

title: Spell invocation applies direct spell-owned conditions with target-action early end
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes authored direct apply_condition effects, slot-scaled touched creature targets, and spell-level target-action early-end triggers. It owns Magic Action and Spell Slot spending, Concentration setup and cleanup, maximum-duration cleanup, Invisible condition application, preservation of independent non-spell condition sources, and source-wide spell expiration after an affected target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

title: Unit feature spends a Bonus Action and Wild Shape use to assume a known Beast Stat Block form
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes caller-supplied known Beast Stat Block identities from the Character Sheet and a shape-admitted Druid Wild Shape Unit support profile. This promoted slice supports the RAW merged-equipment choice only; fallen equipment, worn-equipment practicality, form-limb object handling, Beast Spells, unsupported stat-block action sections, attack prose riders, multi-component damage, stat-block non-Attack actions, non-D20 sense/language/speech projection, and non-battle active-form persistence remain outside this profile. It owns Bonus Action and Wild Shape use spending, Druid-level Temporary Hit Points, active form Stat Block projection of Armor Class, Size, Speed, Beast Dexterity for Mage Armor AC while shaped, supported form attacks with executable attack-roll damage only, Wild Shape D20 statistic projection for Beast Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution plus retained character Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, retained Skill and Saving Throw proficiencies using the character Proficiency Bonus, gained Beast proficiencies and higher Beast stat-block modifiers where present, Beast Strength Shove save DC while shaped, true-form Unarmed Strike ability modifier preservation, no-spellcasting projection for levels before Beast Spells, half-Druid-level duration in hours while inside battle state, active-form Character Sheet handoff blocking, and reversion on dismiss, reuse, Incapacitated, Unconscious, terminal zero Hit Points, or duration expiry.

title: Spell invocation removes one caller-selected condition from a touched creature
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes an authored direct remove_condition choice over Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned for one touched creature. It spends the caster's Bonus Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot, requires a caller-selected target and condition choice, removes the chosen condition plus spell-owned active effects that directly apply it, and preserves unchosen or independent condition sources. Disease, poison-object neutralization, and non-condition remediation are outside this SRD 5.2.1 Lesser Restoration profile.

sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes an authored Alter Self self Spell Effect option choice shape with Aquatic Adaptation, Change Appearance, and Natural Weapons modes. sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Moonbeam spell, caller-supplied Cylinder area identity, movement trigger witnesses, saving throw and damage fills, and the shared shape-shift runtime state for supported class-feature and spell-effect shape-shift owners. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration, active movable area effect state, once-per-creature-per-turn save limiting across Moonbeam area triggers, slot-scaled Radiant damage with half damage on a successful Constitution save, Magic-action beam reposition, failed-save true-form reversion for supported shape-shift owners, Moonbeam-owned shape-shift suppression while the target remains in that Cylinder, explicit Cylinder-exit cleanup, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Heat Metal object-contact Surface shape plus caller-supplied visible manufactured-metal object identity, physical-contact creature witnesses, holding-or-wearing spell-object witnesses, later-turn object-within-range witnesses, Saving Throw outcomes, and typed object-drop resolution fills. sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Gust of Wind spell, caller-supplied self-origin Line area identity, Line direction, affected creatures, failed-save push dispositions, and closer-to-caster movement facts. title: Spell invocation attaches a timed magic-weapon enhancement to an exact weapon item
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Magic Weapon item-enhancement Surface shape plus caller-supplied exact holder-plus-item identity and nonmagical weapon witness facts. It owns Bonus Action level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, one caster-owned item-attached Spell Effect, one-hour duration cleanup, same-caster recast replacement, other-caster active Magic Weapon rejection for the selected holder-plus-item weapon, magic-weapon status projection, and exact holder-plus-item +1/+2/+3 attack-roll and weapon damage-roll projection without mutating authored weapon records or adding spell-owned loadout state. title: Spell invocation creates a Web area hazard with table-triggered restraint, movement, and obscurement projections
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Web spell, caller-supplied point-origin Cube area identity, table-triggered enters-area and starts-turn-in-area save subjects, table-supplied no-longer-in-webs or area-removed cleanup subjects, and caller-supplied movement path facts for travel through active Web Difficult Terrain. sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Levitate creature branch plus caller-supplied visible target, target-within-range, willingness, initial-rise, fixed-object-or-surface movement, and ongoing caster-range witnesses. It owns Magic Action and level-2-or-higher Spell Slot spending, caster-owned Concentration up to 10 minutes, initial suspension up to 20 feet, Constitution save gating for unwilling creatures, active levitated creature state, Magic Action altitude changes up to 20 feet while the target remains within range, target self-movement altitude adjustment when a fixed object or surface within reach is supplied, and cleanup on Concentration or duration end. title: Spell invocation ends tracked ongoing spell effects on a selected target
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Dispel Magic ongoing-spell-ending Surface shape, caller-selected creature/object/magical-effect target identity, caller-supplied target-within-range facts, tracked ongoing Spell Effect facts carried by BattleSpellLightEmitter source spell level, tracked spellObjectContactDamage active-effect occurrences with stable occurrence identity and source spell level, tracked Spiritual Weapon active-effect occurrences with stable sourceEffectId identity and source spell level, active Antimagic Field aura target identity by stable area identity and source combatant identity, and caller-supplied spellcasting ability check totals for higher-level contested spells. Other creature-attached active spell effects, area effects, object effects, and additional spell-specific dispel exceptions or immunities are not represented in the real battle reducer path and remain assigned to the broader ongoing Spell Effect occurrence model; automatic geometry and table selection of magical-effect identity remain outside this subset boundary.

title: Unit feature admits Metamagic selections and rewrites Quickened action spells to Bonus Action
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes Character Battle Metamagic effectKind, stackingMode, Sorcery Point cost facts, and the existing Font of Magic point-pool resource. It admits selected Quickened Spell facts for supported direct Hit Point restoration, scalar buff, save-gated damage, save-gated condition/immunity, direct condition, roll modifier, and direct spell-attack damage action-casting Spell Invocation shapes, enforces known-option and Sorcery Point affordability gates, enforces one-option-per-spell before option-specific support, rejects unsupported second-option effects instead of charging inert Metamagic, spends Bonus Action, Sorcery Points, and required Spell Slots where applicable, and applies the same-turn level-1-plus spell-cast prohibition through a level-1-plus spell turn fact rather than a Spell Slot-only proxy. Standalone damage, control, ongoing-effect, and other Quickened action-casting spell procedures remain tracked by L12G-FOLLOWUP-SORCERER-METAMAGIC-QUICKENED-ALL-ACTION-SPELLS until their owners add typed resource-threading and parity witnesses, and this profile does not claim Sorcery Incarnate, Arcane Apotheosis, or non-Quickened option effects.

title: Unit feature protects selected spell targets with Careful Spell saving throw success
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Careful Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and typed protected-target fills for supported action-time Saving Throw spell procedures. It rejects unknown, unaffordable, non-save, unsupported-mode, repeated, over-count, duplicate, caster, and non-affected protected-target selections before spending resources. Protected non-caster targets must be affected spell targets and must succeed on their Saving Throw; save-for-half damage procedures turn that protected successful save into no damage while save-gated no-effect procedures preserve the base successful-save no-effect result. The profile does not claim Heightened Spell, repeat-save lifecycle targeting, or unsupported cast-property, damage-shape, and reroll Metamagic options.

title: Unit feature gives one selected spell target Heightened Spell Saving Throw Disadvantage
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Heightened Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and one typed target-choice fill for supported action-time Saving Throw spell procedures. It rejects unknown, unaffordable, non-save, unsupported-mode, repeated, and non-affected selected targets before spending resources. The selected affected target receives Disadvantage on the spell's Saving Throw through the shared Saving Throw roll-mode projection, including normal Advantage/Disadvantage cancellation, while ordinary save success, failed-save, damage, no-effect, and Sorcery Point spending behavior remain owned by the base spell procedure. Repeat-save lifecycles remain unsupported until the selected target can be carried through later save holes.

title: Unit feature substitutes listed spell damage types with Transmuted Spell
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Transmuted Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and a cast-selection replacement damage type from the RAW Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, and Thunder set. It rejects unknown, unaffordable, non-action-cast, non-damage, unsupported spell procedures, missing replacement, same-source-target, and non-listed source or target selections before spending resources. Supported save-gated damage, direct spell attack damage, and spell attack sequence procedures project the selected replacement damage type through existing damage holes, damage totals, object damage, creature damage, and attack-hit reaction damage-type facts without changing authored spell identity or duplicating damage dice state.

title: Unit feature increases effective spell level for Twinned Spell target projection
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes Character Battle Twinned Spell typed effectKind facts, the existing Font of Magic point-pool resource, actual Spell Slot level, and Surface target-count projection facts for spells whose higher-level slot shape targets one additional creature. It admits only Spell Slot casts whose current target-list projection matches the actual Spell Slot level being cast and whose next effective spell level increases maximum creature targets by exactly one, projects the invocation target maximum without changing actual Spell Slot spending, spends 1 Sorcery Point from the shared Font of Magic point pool, and rejects unsupported target-count shapes before Sorcery Point spending without dispatching on spell authored identity.

title: Unit feature applies Distant Spell cast-local range increase to promoted target witnesses
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Distant Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, the canonical Surface spell range shape, and a promoted spell target owner that consumes a cast-local range fact. The first promoted owner is object-light targeting for Touch-range Light, which derives a 30-foot Distant range fact for the selected cast, spends 1 Sorcery Point from the shared Font of Magic point pool, preserves the Light spell's Bright and Dim light radii, and rejects unsupported procedures, Self range, sub-5-foot distance ranges, missing Distant range facts, and non-range-bearing target facts before resource spending. Distance-range doubling is modeled in QNT and remains runtime-promoted only when a procedure owner consumes the resulting cast-local range fact.

title: Unit feature applies Extended Spell cast-local duration extension and Concentration save Advantage to promoted duration witnesses
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Extended Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, the canonical Surface duration shape, and a promoted spell procedure owner that consumes a cast-local duration fact. The first promoted owner is Enlarge/Reduce creature size change, which derives a doubled Concentration duration from the Surface 1-minute duration, caps eligible durations at 24 hours in QNT, spends 1 Sorcery Point from the shared Font of Magic point pool, stores the doubled duration on the spell effect's executable cleanup timer, stores same-occurrence Concentration maintenance Saving Throw Advantage on the caster's Concentration state, and rejects unsupported procedures, Instantaneous or sub-1-minute durations, and non-cast subjects before resource spending. Timed-duration projection and additional duration-bearing owners remain runtime-promoted only when their procedure owners consume the cast-local duration fact.

title: Unit feature applies Subtle Spell cast-local component suppression projection
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Subtle Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and canonical Surface spell component requirements. It derives a cast-local component projection for action-time spell casts, suppresses Verbal and Somatic components, suppresses only focus-replaceable Material components, preserves consumed or priced Material component requirements, rejects non-action-time spell casts and spells with no component requirements before resource spending, and leaves stealth, audibility, visibility, Counterspell, hidden-caster, free-hand, Silence, and future procedure-specific component consumers outside this profile subset.

sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes an installed Surface Spell Definition shape with caller-selected creature recipients, slot-scaled Hit Point healing, a granted Short Rest benefit, and a same-spell recipient lockout reset by the recipient finishing a Long Rest. The runtime spends one Spell Slot at completion, applies existing Short Rest benefit logic per selected Character Sheet without duplicating rest algorithms, applies capped spell healing from caller-supplied dice, stores only the same-spell recipient lockout source reference in Long Rest-cleared sheet rest state, and leaves completed 10-minute casting, range maintenance, and interruption tracking to caller/table facts.

sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes the authored Antimagic Field ongoing-spell suppression shape, a self-origin 10-foot Emanation area identity, and caller-supplied affected tracked ongoing Spell Effect facts. sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes CharacterBuild class progression, selected subclass feature grants, and installed Surface class-feature jump-distance substitution grants to derive optional jump-distance Ability substitutions from source facts rather than storing a parallel movement rule.

title: Character Sheet projects linked special Speeds from retained class features
sourceBoundary: Character Sheet consumes retained class-feature grant_speed facts, including selected subclass feature grants, and preserves linked-speed projections such as Climb Speed equal to Speed as a link to the walk Speed source, not as a copied numeric Speed.

title: Character Creation derives Hit Point maximum bonuses from retained class features
sourceBoundary: Character Creation consumes CharacterBuild class progression, installed Surface class-feature modify_max_hp grants, and class-level scaling facts to derive durable Hit Point maximum bonuses without storing a second HP progression table.

title: Unit feature adds a Spell Slot healing bonus equal to 2 plus the slot level
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface spell_slot_healing_modifier shape for spells the caster casts with a Spell Slot that restore Hit Points on that turn. Battle initialization retains the parsed support profile on the character combatant, and direct Hit Point restoration consumes the existing spell-slot invocation level and healing target facts to add 2 plus the spent Spell Slot level to each healed creature without authored-identity dispatch, duplicate Spell Slot state, or effects on non-slot/non-spell/unsupported healing procedures.

title: Unit feature projects a Magic Action resource-spent healing pool with Bloodied target caps
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface magic_action_healing_pool shape, a referenced Channel Divinity resource Unit, 30-foot point range, Bloodied creature targeting including self, class-level multiplier pool, and half-Hit-Point-maximum per-target cap. Battle runtime retains the selected profile on character combatants, spends the Magic Action and existing Channel Divinity resource, consumes caller-supplied target distribution and range facts, applies healing, and rejects missing-resource, missing-action, non-Bloodied, out-of-range, over-pool, and over-cap fills without authored-identity dispatch or duplicate resource state.

title: Unit feature projects a Magic Action area Constitution save damage plus one-target healing profile
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface magic_action_area_save_damage_healing shape, a referenced Wild Shape resource Unit, a point within 60 feet, a 10-foot-radius Sphere, Constitution save against class spell save DC, Necrotic damage with half damage on success, one healing target in the area, and the SRD Druid-level damage/healing dice thresholds. Battle runtime retains the selected profile, derives 2d6, 3d6, or 4d6 damage and healing from the existing Druid class level, spends the Magic Action and existing Wild Shape resource, consumes caller-supplied area membership, Saving Throw, damage-roll, and healing-roll facts, applies Necrotic damage with half damage on success, heals one in-area creature, and rejects missing-resource, invalid-area, invalid-save-fill, invalid-healing-target, malformed-roll, and inconsistent scaling-fill cases without duplicating Wild Shape state or geometry.

title: Unit feature grants Temporary Hit Points when an enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points nearby
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface enemy_zero_hit_point_temporary_hit_points trigger and Charisma-modifier-plus-class-level amount with minimum 1. Battle runtime retains the admitted support profile on character combatants, consumes existing damage-source and side-based beneficiary-target enemy relationship facts plus caller-supplied 10-foot beneficiary range facts, and applies ordinary non-stacking Temporary Hit Point replacement when a qualifying enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points without requiring the damage source to be an enemy of the defeated creature or dispatching on authored feature identity.

title: Unit feature admits delegated Bonus Action standard-action permissions
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface bonus_action_delegated_standard_actions shape and preserves its Bonus Action cost as delegated permission metadata. This profile does not claim an independent battle reducer or QNT shell: current battle runtime has no concrete lock, trap, pocket, generic Utilize, or magic-item activation BattleSubject that Fast Hands can wrap without inventing item or object state. The concrete delegated owners must spend the Bonus Action when they consume this profile.

title: Unit feature admits Remarkable Athlete roll and critical-hit movement facts
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface remarkable_athlete shape and projects typed Initiative Advantage, Strength (Athletics) Advantage, and immediate post-Critical Hit half-Speed movement facts without dispatching on feature id. Battle initiative, ability-check, attack-critical, movement, and Opportunity Attack execution must consume these facts in the existing runtime owners before this profile can claim promoted reducer/QNT parity.

title: Unit feature admits Open Hand Technique Flurry of Blows rider choices
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface open_hand_technique shape referencing the Monk Focus Flurry of Blows option and projects typed Addle, Push, and Topple rider facts without duplicating Monk Focus resource state or dispatching on subclass identity. Battle runtime consumes the retained profile from supported Flurry of Blows hit windows, applies Addle Opportunity Attack denial, gates Push and Topple behind the required failed Saving Throws, validates Push distance/disposition facts, treats successful saves as no-ops, and rejects stale, non-Flurry, unsupported-disposition, and missing-profile cases through the existing Monk Focus, attack, Saving Throw, forced-movement, and condition owners.

title: Unit feature activates Sacred Weapon and applies the bound weapon attack, damage, light, and lifecycle effects
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface sacred_weapon shape and referenced Paladin Channel Divinity resource and projects typed action, resource-spend, held-melee-weapon, Charisma attack-roll bonus, normal-or-Radiant damage choice, light facts, and dismissal facts without duplicating item or resource state. Battle initialization retains the selected Sacred Weapon support profile on character combatants. Battle resource projection admits only the Paladin Channel Divinity use-count resource required by this Sacred Weapon spend path, not every Channel Divinity-shaped resource container. Battle action discovery and resolution consume existing action economy state, existing Paladin Channel Divinity resource state, and existing selected loadout/weapon attack facts to offer Sacred Weapon only for an available Attack action, an available use, and a held Melee weapon; activation spends the Attack action and one use, records a single active binding to the selected weapon item, rejects stale missing-resource or Ranged-weapon subjects, and replaces the previous binding on recast. The active binding is then consumed by attack, damage-type, light-projection, no-action dismissal, timed-expiration, and no-longer-carried cleanup owners, deriving all executable facts from the support profile, existing character statistics, selected loadout weapon state, and active-effect lifecycle.

title: Unit feature admits Hunter's Prey Colossus Slayer and Horde Breaker choice facts
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface hunters_prey choose-one shape and projects typed Colossus Slayer and Horde Breaker option facts without storing a parallel weapon or target model. Character finalization records the selected option on the selected Unit ref, character-to-battle handoff preserves that typed option in BattleUnitRef, and battle runtime consumes existing weapon-hit, target Hit Point, once-per-turn, same-weapon, damage-rider, and caller-supplied target-predicate facts to resolve optional Colossus Slayer and Horde Breaker while rejecting missing selection, same target, invalid predicate, and repeated-use cases without authored-identity dispatch.

title: Unit feature spends a Bonus Action to gain next-attack Advantage and Speed 0
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface steady_aim shape and projects typed Bonus Action, no-prior-movement, next-attack-roll Advantage, and Speed-zero-until-end-of-turn facts. Battle runtime consumes the profile through existing movementSpentFeet, current Bonus Action, nextAttackRollBySelf active-effect, Speed projection, and turn-end cleanup state without duplicating movement history, action economy state, or Speed state.

title: Unit feature admits Potent Cantrip miss/save-success half-damage facts
sourceBoundary: Battle Unit admission consumes the authored Surface potent_cantrip shape and projects typed damaging-cantrip creature-target half-damage facts for attack misses and successful target saves while excluding additional effects and cantrip identity dispatch. Battle runtime retains the selected profile on character combatants and consumes it in existing spell attack, spell save, cantrip-damage, and additional-effect owners to apply half damage on supported creature-target cantrip misses or successful saves, suppress non-damage effects on those branches, and reject object-target or unsupported cantrip cases without authored cantrip identity dispatch.

title: Unit feature applies Seeking Spell missed spell attack reroll
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Seeking Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and the pending single spell-attack-damage Attack Roll fill. A missed spell attack can reopen that same Attack Roll hole with a typed Seeking Spell reroll option; a reroll fill carries the original missed d20 and the forced replacement d20, spends 1 Sorcery Point only when the replacement is used, resolves hit, miss, natural-1 miss, and natural-20 critical from the replacement, and may combine with at most one different Metamagic option used for the same spell. Unknown options, unaffordable spends, original hits, generic miss-to-hit replacements, unsupported procedures, and repeated spell attack sequences are rejected before Sorcery Point spending without storing durable reroll opportunity state.

title: Unit feature applies Empowered Spell damage dice reroll
sourceBoundary: The runtime consumes selected Empowered Spell Metamagic effectKind and Sorcery Point cost facts from the character's known Metamagic options, the existing Font of Magic Sorcery Point point-pool, and the pending single spell-attack-damage rolledDice fill. A promoted Ray of Frost level-5 damage roll can carry a typed Empowered Spell reroll option; a reroll fill carries selected original damage dice and forced replacement dice, spends 1 Sorcery Point only when replacement dice are used, applies the replacement dice before damage totals, enforces the Charisma-modifier minimum-one selected-die limit, and may combine with at most one different Metamagic option used for the same spell. Unknown options, unaffordable spends, mismatched original dice, duplicate or non-existing dice positions, out-of-range replacement dice, over-limit selections, Scorching Ray repeated attack sequences, Magic Missile allocation, Saving Throw area damage, ongoing damage, object damage, and other non-promoted damage owners are rejected before Sorcery Point spending without storing durable reroll opportunity state.
